sentences.text: The chart is a vertical bar chart comparing net worth across six categories, with an annotation for ultra-rich households.
Starting at the bottom, the cashier’s net worth is -$4,000.
The next bars show a working mom at $1,000 and an office clerk at $2,000.
Further up, a nurse has a net worth of $26,000 and a teacher has $32,000.
The accountant’s net worth is $110,000, the highest value displayed on the axis.
The ultra-rich households annotation has no displayed bar value because its net worth is far beyond the displayed axis.
The resulting contrast is modest or negative net worth for ordinary occupations versus wealth concentrated at the ultra-rich end.
That contrast is the basis for showing how a wealth tax could target ultra-rich wealth to finance programs.
